set.body:
Scope: Generic surface lookup/geodesic/sphere kernels; ../mesh4s; surface loader admission.

Deliverable: Upstream only required generic mesh capabilities. Keep hemisphere, medial-wall/template routes and format policy downstream. Implement U0 strict/raw admission decisions.

Acceptance:
- Orientation conflicts, duplicate faces, boundaries, disconnected and non-manifold specimens produce the declared result or typed diagnostic/refusal.
- No silent reorientation, repair, dropping or renumbering of cells occurs.
- Generic kernels have one implementation and JVM/JS parity; neuro-specific policies remain outside mesh4s.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U3: Move reusable mesh kernels and make input admission explicit
